messages.english: The provider describes S-map Online as an interactive soil map with location-specific fact sheets. Its overview shows incomplete coverage and conflicting descriptions of farmable-land coverage.
The overview gives different licence descriptions. The S-map Online terms describe noncommercial, no-derivatives use and a separate commercial arrangement. Individual layer rights remain unverified.
Public overview. The provider describes a free login for map and fact-sheet access. The LRIS layer page did not expose layer access requirements.
The linked reference does not establish site coverage, soil measurements or crop recommendations. No map, fact sheet, layer or data service was accessed.
